name: Prized Amalgam
clause: Whenever a creature enters, if it entered from your graveyard or you cast it from your graveyard, return ~ from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped at the beginning of the next end step.

needs.proposedSignature: Filter: { enteredZoneFrom?: 'battlefield' | 'graveyard' | 'hand' | 'exile' | 'library'; sinceTurn?: 'this-turn' }  ·  Condition: { kind: 'card-left-your-graveyard-this-turn' }  ·  TriggerEvent etb: { on: 'etb', self, filter, from?: 'graveyard' }
needs.semantics: Record, per object, the zone it came from and the turn it arrived (a per-turn field on the object, wiped at cleanup like `ext.damagedBy`), and expose it as a Filter field plus a per-player 'a card left your graveyard this turn' flag. This is the single missing fact behind four different clauses in this batch.
